died.name: Victims of the Gillingham Fair fire disaster
died.cause: In Gillingham, Kent, an annual firefighting demonstration involving a rescue operation inside a three-storey dummy house was hosted at a fair in Gillingham park. The real fire was accidentally lit after the six men and nine boys aged between 10 and 14 were ready to enact their staged rescue. The canvas-clad wooden structure was quickly engulfed in flames, trapping the occupants inside. The crowd reportedly cheered and applauded for what they believed to be realistic and spectacular effects until they witnessed two boys with their clothing ablaze jump to their deaths from the top of the structure. The fire resulted in the deaths of 15 people.
